map.根据清洁面积与清洁类型估算所需工时与人员配置: Estimate required man-hours and staffing based on cleaning area and type
map.📖 查看「清洁工时估算器 使用指南」: 📖 View the User Guide for Cleaning Man-Hour Estimator
map.所需工时(小时) = 清洁面积(m²) ÷ 单人单位效率(m²/小时) × 脏污: Required man-hours (h) = cleaning area (m2) / per-person efficiency (m2/h) x dirt coefficient; per-person efficiency by type (daily cleaning 200-300 m2/h, deep cleaning 40-80 m2/h, post-construction cleaning 20-40 m2/h); dirt coefficient: light 1.0, medium 1.3, heavy 1.8; required staff = total hours / planned duration, per-person hours = total hours / staff.
map.：约 8-12 分钟/㎡，含地面、桌面、卫生间基础清洁: : about 8-12 min/m2, including floor, desk and basic restroom cleaning
map.：约 15-25 分钟/㎡，装修后首次全面清洁: : about 15-25 min/m2, first full cleaning after renovation
map.：约 12-20 分钟/㎡，含厨卫深度、玻璃等: : about 12-20 min/m2, including deep kitchen/restroom and glass
map.：约 3-8 分钟/㎡，需专业设备与高空作业: : about 3-8 min/m2, requires professional equipment and high-altitude work
map.：约 5-10 分钟/㎡，含预喷、抽洗、烘干: : about 5-10 min/m2, including pre-spray, extraction and drying
map.• 实际工时受房屋格局、物品多少、设备效率影响: • Actual man-hours are affected by layout, belongings and equipment efficiency
map.• 建议 2-3 人一组，提高效率并兼顾安全: • Suggest 2-3 people per team to improve efficiency and safety
map.物业投标或包月报价时，先按面积与区域类型估算人时，再乘以单价得出报价，避免拍脑袋: When bidding or quoting a monthly contract, first estimate person-hours by area and zone type, then multiply by unit price for the quote, avoiding missed items from guesswork.
map.新交付楼盘开荒保洁，按面积与重污系数核算工期，决定需进场多少人、几天完成。: For a newly delivered building's post-construction cleaning, compute the schedule by area and heavy-soil coefficient to decide how many people and days are needed.
map.大型活动前后临时加洁，根据人流量与脏污快速估算需增援的保洁人数。: For temporary extra cleaning before/after large events, quickly estimate the relief cleaners needed from foot traffic and soiling.
map.1000㎡ 办公室日常清洁工时示例: Example: 1000 m2 Office Daily Cleaning Man-Hours
map.区域类型选办公室、脏污等级选轻污，按基准人时率约 0.02 人时/㎡ 估算约 2: Choose office zone type and light soiling; at a baseline of about 0.02 person-hours/m2, estimate about 20 person-hours; with two shifts, about 2-3 people work one day.
map.重污系数一般取多少？: What dirt coefficient is generally used?
map.日常轻污系数约 1.0，中度脏污取 1.3~1.5，开荒或重油污可取 1.8~2: Daily light soiling about 1.0, medium soiling 1.3-1.5, post-construction or heavy grease 1.8-2.0; final value by on-site survey.
map.估算含不含更换耗材的时间？: Does the estimate include time to replace consumables?
map.默认只含清洁作业人时，不含领取、补充垃圾袋与清洁剂以及设备充电等辅助时间，需另行: By default it includes only cleaning labour hours, not auxiliary time like fetching, replenishing trash bags and cleaner, or charging equipment; add those separately.
map.外墙或高空作业算在内吗？: Are exterior or high-altitude jobs included?
map.不算。本工具针对室内平面清洁，外墙、高空玻璃属专项作业，需单独按立面面积与安全级: No. This tool targets indoor flat-surface cleaning; exterior walls and high-altitude glass are specialised jobs, calculated separately by facade area and safety level.
map.清洁工时估算器，根据清洁面积、清洁类型与污脏程度，估算总工时与每人工时，辅助人员: Cleaning Man-Hour Estimator estimates total and per-person man-hours from area, type and dirt level, aiding staffing and schedule planning.
